app.title: cambio Tarif-Check
app.subtitle: Find out which cambio tariff would have been the cheapest for your trips.

footer.disclaimer: Not an official offer from cambio

dropzone.title: Drop your trip export here
dropzone.hint: or choose files – CSV or Excel (.xlsx), several at once

privacy.title: Your data stays with you
privacy.text: The analysis runs entirely in your browser. Your trips are neither uploaded nor stored.

where.title: Where do I get the export?
where.text: You can find the export in the cambio customer portal under “Fahrtenarchiv” (trip archive). Pick the period you want there and download the table as CSV or Excel.

import.completeness: The analysis is only correct if the export contains all trips of the period – including those of any additional drivers.

reasons.end-before-start: Booking end is before its start
reasons.before-price-data: Trip is older than the stored prices

errors.unsupported: This file type or table is not supported. Please use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file from the trip archive.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read. It may be damaged or structured differently than expected.
errors.too-large: The file is larger than 5 MB and was not read.

import.skipped: Skipped – the columns were not mapped.

mapping.title: Map columns
mapping.description: Not all columns in “{{file}}” could be recognised. Choose the matching column for each field.
mapping.ambiguous: Several columns match – please pick one.
mapping.duplicate: Each column can only be used for one field.

summary.title: Imported trips
summary.driversHint_one: The export contains {{count}} other driver. It has been entered as an additional driver in the settings.
summary.driversHint_other: The export contains {{count}} other drivers. They have been entered as additional drivers in the settings.
summary.confirmText: All imported trips and settings are removed from the browser. Your files stay untouched.
